As described below, the OpenRESV library together with OpenIPSL provides the model and configuration for each experiment, allowing direct com- parison using a Modelica-based tool. The repository also includes instructions for perform- ingthesecomparisons. The experiments in [16] focus on different inverter control configurations. For example, in the Unity Power Factor case, only three experiments were conducted. This number of experiments is too small to support meaningful variability analysis or confidence interval estimation. In other cases, only one or two experiments were performed, which similarly prevents reliable statistical analysis.
